body:
### Problem

Proper implementation of `reuse_client` predicate for public lsp configs hosted in [neovim/nvim-lspconfig](https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig) requires reimplementing default client and workspace detection logic.

Basically, contributors, who want to add some custom reuse client conditions to public lsp configs, required to
reimplement at least default client and workspace detection logic, and be aware of `reuse_client_default` behavior for reference.
<details>
<summary>
reuse_client_default
</summary>

https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/fbc5a769aa44c3a66f1ddd59cc9930c0dd7f365b/runtime/lua/vim/lsp.lua#L120-L148
</details>

Let's take for example a use-case of reusing client for language standard library paths.

Here my implementation with `reuse_client` for `gopls`.

<details>
<summary>
gopls.lua
</summary>

```lua
---@param env_var_name string
---@param sub_dir string?
---@return string?
local function get_go_env_dir_path(env_var_name, sub_dir)
  if vim.fn.executable('go') == 0 then
    return nil
  end

  local cmd = { 'go', 'env', env_var_name }
  local out = vim.system(cmd, { text = true }):wait()
  local path = vim.trim(out.stdout or '')

  if out.code ~= 0 or path == '' then
    return nil
  end

  return vim.fs.normalize(vim.fs.joinpath(path, sub_dir or ''))
end

---@param config_folder lsp.WorkspaceFolder
local function reuse_go_client_for_go_std_paths(config_folder)
  local std_lib_path = get_go_env_dir_path('GOROOT', 'src') or ''
  local mod_cache_path = get_go_env_dir_path('GOMODCACHE') or ''
  local config_folder_path = vim.fs.normalize(vim.uri_to_fname(config_folder.uri))
  local reuse_client_for_std_lib = vim.fs.relpath(std_lib_path, config_folder_path) ~= nil
  local reuse_client_for_mod_cache = vim.fs.relpath(mod_cache_path, config_folder_path) ~= nil

  return reuse_client_for_std_lib or reuse_client_for_mod_cache
end

---@param client vim.lsp.Client
---@param config vim.lsp.ClientConfig
---@return boolean
local function reuse_go_client(client, config)
    if client.name ~= config.name or client:is_stopped() then
    return false
  end

  local config_folders = lsp._get_workspace_folders(config.workspace_folders or config.root_dir)

  if not config_folders or not next(config_folders) then
    -- Reuse if the client was configured with no workspace folders
    local client_config_folders = lsp._get_workspace_folders(client.config.workspace_folders or client.config.root_dir)
    return not client_config_folders or not next(client_config_folders)
  end

  for _, config_folder in ipairs(config_folders) do
    local found = false
    for _, client_folder in ipairs(client.workspace_folders or {}) do
      if client_folder.uri == config_folder.uri then
        found = true
        break
      end
    end

    if not found and not reuse_for_go_std_paths(config_folder) then
      return false
    end
  end

  return true
end

---@type vim.lsp.Config
return {
  cmd = { 'gopls' },
  filetypes = { 'go', 'gomod', 'gowork', 'gotmpl' },
  root_dir = function(bufnr, on_dir)
    local fname = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(bufnr)

    local root_markers = vim.fn.has('nvim-0.11.3') == 1 and { { 'go.work' }, { 'go.mod' }, { '.git' } }
      or { 'go.work', 'go.mod', '.git' }

    on_dir(vim.fs.root(fname, root_markers))
  end,
  reuse_client = function(client, config)
    return reuse_go_client(client, config)
  end,
  settings = {
    gopls = {
      analyses = {
        nilness = true,
        unusedparams = true,
        unusedwrite = true,
        useany = true,
      },
      codelenses = {
        test = true,
      },
      hints = {
        assignVariableTypes = true,
        compositeLiteralFields = true,
        compositeLiteralTypes = true,
        constantValues = true,
        functionTypeParameters = true,
        parameterNames = true,
        rangeVariableTypes = true,
      },
      semanticTokens = true,
    },
  },
}
```
</details>

 `reuse_go_client` function took 30+ lines, because I copied default behavior, and put  needed condition.

Prompted by:

- [comment](https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/pull/4491#issuecomment-5183234713) in neovim/nvim-lspconfig#4491 -- contributor put reuse client logic into `root_dir` predicate.
- [gopls.lua](https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig/blob/684cb45c2faa24ce463b4fe9aaf011bfe1e0fb26/lsp/gopls.lua#L104-L120) -- reuse client logic in `root_dir` predicate

### Expected behavior

At least visible `reuse_client_default` reference in `vim.lsp.Config.reuse_client` documentation, or exposed default client and workspace detection logic with ability to put custom conditions.
